text.en:
All laws, orders, issuances, rules and regulations, or
parts thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order, are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect on I January 1994.
Done in the City of Manila, this 234 day of DECEMBER, in the year
of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Three.
By the President:
GUINdUNA, JR.
AC Executive Secretary
